title: CNTi Test Suite evidence statement
description: Schema for cnti-evidence.json, written by `cnti-testsuite evidence`: an in-toto Statement (v1) with the Test Result predicate (v0.1) whose subject is the results file, plus the `cnti` block a reader needs without opening the results YAML.

subject.description: The results file the statement is about, by content digest.

result.description: PASSED when the run met its objective, FAILED otherwise (an errored run is FAILED).

configuration.description: The configuration the run used, copied into the bundle's config/ directory: the cnti-testsuite.yaml the install was given and every values file it names, each by its path in the bundle and its digest. Empty when no CNF was installed when evidence ran.

cnti.description: What the badge and the summary say, as a reader needs them: taken from the results file.

task.description: The task that produced the results file, e.g. cert.

label.description: The badge's label: CNTi essential for the cert task, CNTi <task> otherwise.

criteria.description: The results file's summary.criteria, verbatim; null when the run had none.

run_date.description: From the results file's timestamp name (UTC, RFC 3339), else the file's modification time.

results_file.description: The results file's name, as the subject names it.

self_published.description: Always true: the statement is produced by the project's own run, not by a CNTi review.

published_files.description: Set by a publisher: the extra files published with the bundle, relative to the project's workspace.

withheld_files.description: Set by a publisher: the extra files named for publishing but withheld (an exclude pattern matched).

run_url.description: Set by a publisher: the URL of the pipeline run, when it is visible.

provenance.description: Who signed the bundle and how a reader verifies it. Written as `none` by `cnti-testsuite evidence`; the job that signs replaces it.

method.description: sigstore-keyless: cosign with the CI's OIDC identity (proves the pipeline); key: cosign or gpg with a project key (proves the publisher); github-attestation: GitHub artifact attestations (proves the workflow); none: unsigned.

files.description: The signature or bundle files next to the evidence (e.g. cnti-evidence.json.sigstore.json, cnti-evidence.json.sig and the public key); empty for github-attestation (stored by GitHub) and none.

identity.description: What a reader verifies against: the signing identity for sigstore-keyless (the workflow's URL) and github-attestation (owner/repository), the public key's name or fingerprint for key, null for none.
